qualifiedVerdicts.content: Review 001 on the staged candidate tree 4fdfa8d over ff841a6 (blind kanji-accuracy-reviewer subagent; underlying model assigned by the runtime and not disclosed). The tree was committed unchanged as candidate 5baf298 after GPG signing became available (tree identity verified). Verdicts: correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN; comprehensibility CLEAN; quiz safety NEEDS FIX (F1, minor, medium confidence: 預ける «отдавать на хранение; оставлять под присмотром» lacked a guard against 頼む «просить; поручать», since JMdict gives 預ける "to leave (a matter) in someone's hands" and 頼む "to entrust to", and Russian «поручить» also means leaving someone in another's care). The reviewer checked the Russian-only adaptations of 頬, 離婚, 霜, 革, 電子 and 除く and every guard beyond EN, and found no unjustified guard. Fix commit bacc91b: 預ける guards 頼む; two optional polish items were accepted (頼る title and H1 «полагаться; опираться (на кого-л./что-л.)», and the 雷 meaning paragraph reworded without the English comparison). Recheck 001 on the fix diff: F1 and both polish items resolved, the manifest hashes for the three changed files match, no regressions in the changed passages, and the remaining optional items accepted as declined; correctness, scoped coverage, comprehensibility and quiz safety CLEAN.

qualifiedVerdicts.quizTitles: Title/stem screen hand-checked; author guards beyond EN added 食品-食糧 (shared food sense), 食卓-テーブル («стол»), 食う-召し上がる/いただく/取る (the eating sense across registers) and 食う-掛かる (時間を食う «отнимать время»), 飛行-飛ぶ, 飛び出す-出る, 除く-以外 (〜を除いて «кроме») and 除く-取る («убирать»), 飛ばす-投げる, 風景-山水 (following 景色), 題-名前 («название»), 期間-時代/間, 時-ころ/場合/機会/ケース, 時期-時間/ころ/間/季節, 頃-ころ/くらい/ほど/時間/約/ほぼ/およそ/ばかり/そろそろ, 表面-表/格好, 面-表/点, 非常-非常に/極/大変/特別, 霧-もやもや, 雷-ごろごろ, 需要-必要, 離婚-別れる, 去る-出る/行く/出かける/立つ/過ぎる/亡くなる and 離れる-遠い/遠く. The review added 預ける-頼む (RU «оставлять под присмотром» against 頼む «поручать»; JMdict 預ける "to leave (a matter) in someone's hands", 頼む "to entrust to"). The reviewer classified 食品-食糧, 食う-召し上がる/いただく/取る, 飛ばす-投げる, 題-名前, 期間-間, 時期-間, 頃-時間, 非常-大変, 雷-ごろごろ, 需要-必要, 去る-行く/出かける, 離れる-遠い/遠く and 預ける-頼む as conservative (dictionary basis present, quiz necessity not established), 霧-もやもや and 非常-特別 as between conservative and needed, and the rest as needed. All pairs are one-sided direct pairs; no existing card was changed for guards. Every EN exclusion is retained; no batch word has EN quiz_distractors. Screen-driven title choices during authoring: 風景 «пейзаж; сцена (из жизни)» avoids «картина» (a segment of 絵 «рисунок; картина»), 時期 «время (для чего-либо); период» avoids «пора» (the first segment of 頃), and 食う «есть (разг., грубовато); отнимать (время)» marks the register in the title.
